title: Explorar Proyectos
brief: New designs for the project catalog of the UNIMAYOR IoT project bank, ready for 210 projects in 21 areas (100 current + 11 new areas with 10 projects each) and 80+ sectors; links each project to the journal finder.

artboards.title: Catálogo facetado
artboards.tradeoff: Fast, precise filtering with counts per area family and level; denser screen that suits teachers and researchers more than first-time students

artboards.title: Explorar por familias de áreas
artboards.tradeoff: Best discovery and clearly showcases the 11 new areas and student profiles; adds one click before reaching the project list

artboards.title: Lista con vista previa
artboards.tradeoff: Compare projects quickly without leaving the list, with objectives, stack and journals visible; needs a separate mobile layout and shows fewer projects at a glance
